OPERATION MANUAL / 操作手册NO. 01 — STRUCTURAL SURVEY
ELEVEN DECKS. SIX ROOMS. FOUR TURRETS.

拆开她。
TAKE HER APART.

一层一层剥开俾斯麦号的装甲与甲板，进入炮塔、锅炉舱与轮机舱。每一条线、每一块钢板，均由代码现场生成。

Peel back the decks and armour of the Bismarck, then step inside her turrets, boiler rooms and turbine spaces. Every plate and rivet is generated live in code — no model files.
